channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cameron Boozer | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cameron Boozer from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Carlos Boozer on Chris Webber, Cameron Boozer
item.description:
Carlos Boozer on his son Cameron Boozer:

“I'm proud of him. First off, first off, I know this has been his dream to be in this position, to be in the NBA and have a chance to play for a team that loves him. And so, I just hope him to take in these moments like be where your feet are. Be present, enjoy these moments because they go by so fast. I still remember my first game against Sacramento back in 2002 when they had Chris Webber. And I was, you know, 20 something years ago. So I just hope him to be where your feet are, be as present as you can be, enjoy every moment, because they go by so fast.”

Carlos Boozer on Chris Webber, Cameron Boozer, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Carlos Boozer on Cameron Boozer
item.description:
To his delight, Boozer was actually recognized for another reason.​

“’Hey, Mr. Boozer, you’re Cameron and Cayden’s dad?’ I get that all the time,”

Carlos Boozer on Cameron Boozer, Apr 14, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Carlos Boozer on Cameron Boozer
item.description:
“It probably happened for the first time two or three years ago. Every game they play is at an NBA level [of interest]… Their game has gone viral since they were freshman [in high school]. ​“I’m proud of them. I was in San Antonio and went to play golf. And a guy said, ‘Oh my God, you’re Cameron and Cayden’s dad!’ I was like, ‘Damn right I am.’”

Carlos Boozer on Cameron Boozer, Apr 14, 2025. Source: Andscape.
